title: Frozen Heart Totem of Undying
description: This resource pack changes the texture of te totem of undying to a heart one.
body:
# Frozen Heart Totem of Undying
Give your Totem of Undying a chilling new look! This resource pack replaces the default totem with a Frozen Heart, inspired by icy, frozen-themed visuals that add a cold but magical twist to your survival experience.

### Why download it?

- Cool Icy Aesthetic: A frosty heart design that stands out while still keeping a clean Minecraft vibe.
- Perfect for Winter Worlds: Amazing for snowy survival bases, frozen biomes, or holiday RPG servers.
- Vanilla-Friendly: Designed to match Minecraft’s original art style without feeling out of place.
- Lightweight & Compatible: Works perfectly with shaders and all other resource packs.

Survive with a heart as cold as ice—literally!

## Terms of Use

You are free to use this resource pack in Minecraft, your videos, and your modpacks.

If you include it in a modpack or showcase it in a video, I would appreciate it if you add a link to this page in the description.

_**Do not redistribute or claim the pack as your own.**_
